include.description: Glob patterns of files to scan across the project.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files or directories to exclude.

replaceDefaultExcludes.description: When true, replaces built-in excludes (node_modules, dist, .git) instead of appending.

outputCss.description: Output path for the generated centralized Tailwind CSS file.

dictionaryFile.description: Path for Class List Mode dictionary output and lookup.

manifestFile.description: Path for the revert manifest generated during apply.

cssFormat.description: Target CSS wrapper syntax for @apply rules.

minOccurrences.description: Minimum number of occurrences across the site to extract a pattern.

minClasses.description: Minimum number of Tailwind utilities required in an extractable pattern.

maxClasses.description: Maximum number of Tailwind utilities in a pattern (0 = no maximum).

minFiles.description: Minimum number of distinct files a pattern must appear in.

subsetMatching.description: Detect shared base layouts and replace conflict-free utility subsets while keeping extra modifiers inline.

subsetMinClasses.description: Minimum class count required for subset/shared-base matching.

classPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every generated semantic class name (e.g. 'tc-').

namingStyle.description: Formatting style for auto-generated class names.

tailwindPrefix.description: Custom Tailwind utility prefix configured in your project (e.g. 'tw-').

comments.description: Include descriptive comments and occurrence counts in generated CSS.

groupByCategory.description: Group generated CSS selectors by UI category.

scanHelpers.description: Extract static class literals inside clsx(), cn(), twMerge(), classNames(), and cva().

strictDictionary.description: When using a dictionary, ignore newly added repeated patterns not listed in the dictionary.

excludeClasses.description: Utility globs to never extract into @apply (always kept inline on elements).

includeClasses.description: Optional allowlist of utility globs eligible for extraction.

excludePatterns.description: Marker classes that opt an entire element out of auto-classing (e.g. 'tc-ignore').

ignoreTags.description: HTML/JSX element tags to skip during scanning.

onlyTags.description: Restrict scanning exclusively to these HTML/JSX element tags.

rules.description: Custom heuristic naming rules evaluated before built-in archetypes.
